content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user viewing the task report","i_want":"to filter the report tasks by Status, Priority and Date Range","so_that":"I see only the tasks that match the criteria I need to review","business_description":"The Task Reporting page lists the user's tasks. The user can narrow the list by Status (Open, In Progress, Completed), by Priority (Low, Medium, High) and by a Date Range. The backend report endpoint applies these filters so that the table shows only matching tasks.","business_value":"The user can focus on a subset of tasks, such as all High priority tasks or all tasks in a chosen date window, without scanning the full report.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"The report contains tasks with Open, In Progress and Completed status","when":"The user selects the status filter value Open on the reporting page","then":"The report table lists only tasks whose status is Open and no other tasks"},{"given":"The report contains tasks with Low, Medium and High priority","when":"The user selects the priority filter value High on the reporting page","then":"The report table lists only tasks whose priority is High and no other tasks"},{"given":"The report contains tasks with dates both inside and outside a chosen range","when":"The user sets a Date Range on the reporting page","then":"The report table lists only tasks whose date value, for the date field confirmed in the open question in the edge cases, falls inside the range"},{"given":"The report API is called with a status, a priority or a date range filter","when":"The request is sent with one or more filter values","then":"The response contains only the tasks that match the filter values sent, and the count in the response equals the number of returned tasks"},{"given":"A filter request to the report API fails with an error response","when":"The user changes a filter on the reporting page","then":"The table does not show the filtered result as applied, and the page shows an error state instead of a success state"}],"edge_cases":["Open question: the PRD does not state which date field (Creation Date, Due Date, Last Updated Date or Completion Date) the Date Range filter applies to. The date field must be confirmed before the date filter is built.","Open question: the PRD does not state whether the Date Range bounds are inclusive. Tasks dated exactly on a bound are included or excluded depending on this decision.","Open question: the PRD does not state how multiple filters combine (for example Status and Priority set together). The combination rule must be confirmed.","A filter with no value selected is not applied, and the report shows all tasks for that filter.","A filter value outside the allowed values (Open, In Progress, Completed for Status; Low, Medium, High for Priority) is treated as invalid input and rejected by the backend.","A Date Range whose start is later than its end is treated as invalid input and rejected by the backend.","A filter request that returns no matching tasks returns an empty result with a count of 0."],"dependencies":["US-create-task","US-view-task-report"],"definition_of_done":["The report endpoint accepts status, priority and date range filter parameters and returns only matching tasks.","The response count equals the number of returned tasks for every filtered request.","The date field used for the Date Range is confirmed and documented in the story.","Status and Priority filter controls and the Date Range control are visible on the Task Reporting page.","The frontend shows no successful filtered state when the filter request fails.","Automated tests for each filter pass and are linked to the story."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"report-tasks-filter-api","title":"[BE] Add status, priority and date range filters to the report tasks endpoint","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Extend the report tasks endpoint so that it accepts optional status, priority and date range filter values, applies them to the stored tasks, and returns the matching tasks with a count of returned tasks. Only the filter part of the shared report API is implemented here; search, sort and metric aggregation belong to other stories. Invalid filter values are rejected as invalid input.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-5f4ef76c","R-8007d6b5"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Status filter returns only tasks with the requested status.","Priority filter returns only tasks with the requested priority.","Date Range filter returns only tasks whose confirmed date field falls inside the range.","Invalid filter values return an invalid input error.","Response count equals the number of returned tasks.","Unit or integration tests cover each filter and the invalid input case."]},{"key_slug":"report-filter-controls","title":"[FE] Add Status, Priority and Date Range filter controls to the report page","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Add Status and Priority selectors and a Date Range control to the Task Reporting page. Changing a filter calls the report endpoint with the selected values and updates the table only after a successful response. If the request fails, the table does not show the filtered result as applied and an error state is shown.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-5f4ef76c"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Status selector offers Open, In Progress and Completed.","Priority selector offers Low, Medium and High.","Date Range control sets a start and end value sent to the endpoint.","Table updates only after a successful response.","A failed filter request shows an error state and no success state.","Component tests cover selection and the failed request case."]},{"key_slug":"report-filter-tests","title":"[QA] Test suite for report task filters","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"Build the test suite that checks the status, priority and date range filters end to end, including the response count and the failed request behaviour.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-5f4ef76c","R-8007d6b5"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Tests cover the Open status filter and the High priority filter.","Tests cover a Date Range that includes and excludes tasks.","Tests check that the response count equals the number of returned tasks.","Tests check that a failed filter request shows no success state.","The suite runs in the CI pipeline and passes."]}]}
